sn47.49:1.3: Pleasant feeling, painful feeling, neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
sn47.49:1.5: The four establishments of mindfulness are to be developed for the full understanding of these three feelings.
sn47.49:2.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body …
sn47.49:2.5: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.49:2.6: “These four establishments of mindfulness, bhikkhus, are to be developed for the full understanding of these three feelings.”
